idea-plugin.name: RecordBuilder Support
idea-plugin.description:
Provides IDE support for RecordBuilder annotation processor.
Features: - Code completion for generated Builder classes without compilation - Support for builder() factory methods - Support for all builder methods (setXxx, getXxx, hasXxx, clearXxx, build, merge) - Navigation to generated builder classes
Usage: Simply annotate your record with @RecordBuilder, and the IDE will immediately recognize the generated builder class and its methods without requiring compilation.
